263:       }

302:                 continue nextDoc;
303:               } else {
304:                 failedDim = dim;
305:               }
306:             }
307:           }
308:         } else {
309:           // If a sideways dim failed the approximate check, then no second-phase checks can fail:

313:             }

315:             if (dim.twoPhase.matches() == false) {
